steps.promotion_criteria: Direct recruitment through MPESB Combined Group-2 Sub-Group-4 Examination followed by district induction training and CPCT certification.
steps.source_label: MPESB Group-2 Sub-Group-4 & Patwari Recruitment Rulebook 2026, Section 3

steps.promotion_criteria: Promotion through Departmental Promotion Committee (DPC) based on seniority-cum-merit after 5 to 7 years of active service as Patwari and passing the departmental revenue examination, or through limited departmental competitive exam.
steps.source_label: MP Land Records and Revenue Department Service Rules

steps.promotion_criteria: Promotion on recommendation of MPPSC/DPC after completion of prescribed qualifying service as Revenue Inspector (~5 years) with benchmark ACR/APAR gradings.
Seniority-cum-merit promotion from Naib Tehsildar cadre after 5 to 8 years of gazetted judicial and executive revenue administrative service.
steps.source_label: MP State Revenue Service Executive Cadre Regulations

steps.designation: Superintendent of Land Records (SLR) / Deputy Collector (राज्य प्रशासनिक सेवा)
steps.promotion_criteria: Promotion into State Administrative Service (Executive) through MPPSC DPC quota after exemplary field service, subject to availability of cadre vacancies.

official_perks.perk_description: Dearness Allowance computed at the prevailing rate of 58% of basic pay (₹14,674 per month at entry level) under MP State Finance Department orders.
HRA ranging between 8% to 16% of basic pay depending on classification of posting town/district, or allotment of official Patwari Bhawan/residential quarters in the halka.
Monthly fixed allowance for field stationery, basta maintenance, and routine medical outpatient treatment reimbursement.
official_perks.source_label: MP Board of Revenue Administrative Circulars

official_perks.perk_description: Contributory Defined Pension Scheme with 14% matching contribution by the Government of Madhya Pradesh and 10% candidate deduction.
